text:
Kerala has about 12 lakh empty houses, roughly one in ten (Census 2011). Many were built with money earned in the Gulf, for families whose children now live abroad too. Pathanamthitta alone counts over 61,000 closed homes, and in 2023 the state proposed a tax on locked houses, then dropped it within a month.

Would you keep a big house back home if nobody lived in it? #Kerala
